set.body: Slice of bd-01M2T3ZCY7HJNFQ5G0Z6MQND0A, required by acceptance item 3 of epic bd-01KYD6CFWNAN0Y3TR59FJV8VMG (pinned eyesim references for shared relational conventions). eyesim 735d0109, R/regression.R: template_multireg(method='nnls') = nnls::nnls on sum-normalised maps, intercept silently ignored, so it is the same estimand as Template.decomposeNonNegative. template_regression(method='rank') = ppcor::pcor spearman, which is PartialAssociation.of(..., Spearman); its beta_baseline/beta_source labelling is a documented divergence. Work: add nnls and ppcor to tools/r-parity/r-lock.json roots without re-resolving everything; per-ticket case and manifest.d files; an R generator with --check; a suite consuming the generated reference; check_baseline --eyesim --mote. R is an offline oracle only.
set.title: Pinned eyesim parity for NNLS (template_multireg nnls) and partial Spearman (template_regression rank)
